title: Nitrogen enters a living route
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Nitrogen-fixing microorganisms convert N₂ into ammonia, which can become ammonium in water. The diagram summarizes the conversion and omits its enzyme and energy requirements.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain fixation from nitrogen gas to ammonia in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Certain nitrogen-fixing bacteria convert atmospheric nitrogen gas into which form? Nitrogen-fixing microorganisms convert N₂ into ammonia, which can become ammonium in water. The diagram summarizes the conversion and omits its enzyme and energy requirements.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
